notes: RNET-seq: RNAP-protected nascent RNA (6-30 nt) purified on Ni-NTA via His-tagged rpoC; assay nascent_or_labelled, not standard RNA-seq. rpoC-His tag counted as reference. Kanamycin is selection.

assay_class.q: Elution with imidazole generated ECs carrying ~6-30 nt long transcripts

base_medium.q: grown in ~300 ml LB broth +25 mg/ml kanamycin with shaking at 37˚C

culture_mode.q: with shaking at 37˚C until OD600 of ~0.5

treatment.q: We employed RNET-seq to the wild-type (WT) E. coli strain and to an isogenic strain deficient in genes for GreA and GreB
